name: Nalorphine dinicotinate
summary: Nalorphine dinicotinate (trade name Nimelan), also known as N-allylnormorphine dinicotinate, dinicotinoylnalorphine, or niconalorphine, is a semisynthetic, mixed opioid agonist-antagonist which is described as a narcotic antagonist but may produce limited analgesia and sedation at higher doses in opioid naive patients (with limited euphoria and dependence liability).

pharmacology.text: Nalorphine dinicotinate (trade name Nimelan), also known as N-allylnormorphine dinicotinate, dinicotinoylnalorphine, or niconalorphine, is a semisynthetic, mixed opioid agonist-antagonist which is described as a narcotic antagonist but may produce limited analgesia and sedation at higher doses in opioid naive patients (with limited euphoria and dependence liability).

uses.en: It was sold under the trade name Nimelan as a narcotic antagonist, a drug that blocks the effects of opioids.
uses.zh: 它曾以商品名 Nimelan 作為麻醉藥拮抗劑販售，用來阻斷鴉片類藥物的作用。
uses.zhHans: 它曾以商品名 Nimelan 作为麻醉药拮抗剂贩售，用来阻断鸦片类药物的作用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it specifically. Its parent drug nalorphine can cause unpleasant mood changes, anxiety and hallucinations, and drugs of this kind can bring on withdrawal in people dependent on opioids.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它本身所知甚少。它的母體藥物烯丙嗎啡可能引起不愉快的情緒變化、焦慮與幻覺，而這類藥物也可能讓鴉片類藥物依賴者出現戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它本身所知甚少。它的母体药物烯丙吗啡可能引起不愉快的情绪变化、焦虑与幻觉，而这类药物也可能让鸦片类药物依赖者出现戒断反应。

fact.en: It is nalorphine with two groups of nicotinic acid attached. Nicotinic acid is niacin, a form of vitamin B3.
fact.zh: 它是在烯丙嗎啡上接了兩個菸鹼酸基團的化合物，而菸鹼酸就是維生素 B3 的一種形式。
fact.zhHans: 它是在烯丙吗啡上接了两个烟碱酸基团的化合物，而烟碱酸就是维生素 B3 的一种形式。
